newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Chubais sees Russian economic growth next year.
newsitem.headline: Chubais sees Russian economic growth next year.

text.p: The Russian economy will return to growth next year and living standards will start to rise, First Deputy Prime Minister Anatoly Chubais said on Friday.
"Next year in Russia will be the first year of economic growth and the first year of an improvement in living standards," Chubais, who is in charge of reforms, told a news conference.
Chubais said support for economic reform was the strongest he had seen in the Russian government in the last six years. "The team in the new government is an excellent team," he said.
